title: Explain how the Appendix A stakeholder table is used and adapted
requirements:
- Introduce the purpose of the stakeholder table and state that it is illustrative
- Add columns or guidance for each stakeholder's role, interests, contributions, risks and financing role
- Describe country adaptation and link the appendix to governance, roadmap and measurement sections
- Identify accountable operating roles (component operator, steward, conformance authority)
- Recommend analysis of power, conflicts of interest and participation barriers
